name: @pipeworx/mcp-datagouv-fr

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search the data.gouv.fr French open-data catalogue for datasets by keyword, organization slug, or tag; returns dataset titles, slugs, and resource counts with pagination.

tools.name: dataset
tools.description: Single dataset by id or slug.

tools.name: resources
tools.description: List all downloadable resources (CSV, JSON, XLS, API, etc.) attached to a data.gouv.fr dataset, identified by id or slug; returns file URLs, formats, and last-update dates.

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Search data.gouv.fr publishing organizations by name keyword; returns organization names, slugs, and dataset counts — use slugs to filter `search_datasets`.

tools.name: organization
tools.description: Single organization by id or slug.

tools.name: reuses_search
tools.description: Search data.gouv.fr reuses — third-party applications, visualisations, and analyses built on open datasets; returns titles, URLs, and linked dataset references.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-datagouv-fr forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the datagouv-fr pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
